youtube.title: NICK SMITH: Nelson Mayor: The Case for Protecting Electorate MPs
youtube.summary: Talking with Simon O’Connor, former National MP and Nelson mayor Nick Smith challenges criticism of the 2026 election results, arguing that strategic voting has been overstated and that electorate MPs play an essential role in representing local communities. He warns against proposed changes that could undermine electorate representation, calls for electoral law to be protected from political tinkering through a supermajority or referendum and makes the case for a four-year parliamentary term and a simpler supplementary member voting system. youtube.title: DRS SARAH AND RANDALL FARRANT: The Brain’s Nightly Clean-Up — Why Deep Sleep Matters
youtube.summary: Rodney Hide speaks with Drs Sarah and Randall Farrant about the glymphatic system, the brain’s waste-clearance network and its role in maintaining neurological health. They explain how this process becomes more active during sleep and discuss the importance of sleep quality, movement, posture, hydration, nutrition and recovery. They also explore claims linking impaired drainage to neurological conditions and practical ways to support the body’s natural maintenance processes.
